name: attaya-night
description: A dark, playful theme and a little attaya teapot that brews while you code, builds foam while you focus, reheats while you take a break, watches your training runs and pours when things go well.

attaya.roundMinutes.description: Length of each of the three attaya rounds, in minutes.

attaya.breakMinutes.description: Length of the break between rounds, in minutes. The break only counts down while you are away from the editor.

attaya.idleMinutes.description: Minutes without activity before the teapot dozes off and the round pauses.

attaya.boilingThreshold.description: Number of errors across your workspace that makes the teapot boil over.

attaya.showStatusBar.description: Show the round timer in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Add a short Wolof phrase above the mood, with the English on hover.
attaya.language.description: Language for the teapot's little phrases.

attaya.sounds.description: Play small sounds: a pour and a glass clink when Attaya pours, a lid rattle when it boils over. Sounds play while the Attaya sidebar has been opened in this window.

attaya.training.finishPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for the log line that marks the end of a training run. Leave empty for the default, which matches lines like "Training complete" and Hugging Face's "train_runtime".

attaya.prayer.enabled.description: Pause the round and give a gentle reminder at prayer times. Times are calculated offline from your location.

attaya.prayer.latitude.description: Your latitude for prayer times, e.g. 13.4549 for Banjul.

attaya.prayer.longitude.description: Your longitude for prayer times, e.g. -16.5790 for Banjul.

attaya.prayer.method.description: Calculation method for prayer times. Use the one your local mosque follows.

enumDescriptions: Shafi, Maliki and Hanbali: the earlier Asr time.
attaya.prayer.madhab.description: Juristic method for the Asr time.

attaya.prayer.pauseMinutes.description: How long the round stays paused at a prayer time. Press Resume to carry on sooner.

enumDescriptions: On during Ramadan by the Umm al-Qura calendar. Local moon sighting can differ by a day; switch it on or off by hand if so.
attaya.prayer.ramadanMode.description: In Ramadan mode the teapot rests from Fajr until iftar (Maghrib). Needs prayer times to be enabled.
